name: Add Contacts to Sequence
description: Adds one or more contacts to a sequence in Apollo.io. [See the documentation](https://apolloio.github.io/apollo-api-docs/?shell#add-contacts-to-sequence)

configurable_props.name: contactIds
configurable_props.label: Contact IDs
configurable_props.description: Identifiers of the contacts to add to sequence

configurable_props.name: emailAccountId
configurable_props.label: Email Account ID
configurable_props.description: Identifier of the email account to send email from

configurable_props.name: sequenceNoEmail
configurable_props.label: Sequence No Email
configurable_props.description: Whether to still sequence the contact if he/she does not have an email address

configurable_props.name: sequenceActiveInOtherCampaigns
configurable_props.label: Sequence Active in Other Campaigns
configurable_props.description: Whether to still sequence the contact if he/she is active or paused in another sequence

configurable_props.name: sequenceFinishedInOtherCampaigns
configurable_props.label: Sequence Finished in Other Campaigns
configurable_props.description: Whether to still sequence the contact if he/she already finished another sequence
